title: Compress Runs
description: Write a function named compress_runs that compresses a string by replacing each contiguous run of the same character with the character followed by the length of the run. Return an empty string if text is empty.

hidden_tests.kind: a single long run of identical characters

hints: Run-length encoding requires tracking the current active character and its consecutive frequency count.
Examine loop termination: the final run has no subsequent character change to trigger appending to the result.
Flush the final accumulated run after the loop completes: append f'{current_char}{count}' before returning.
